result:
Any task page whose folder holds subtasks now has a Tree tab with Lanes, Outline and Flow views, and the map of every view is written up. I checked it only on this run's own task at 400, 1200 and 1920 wide, and I skipped 3440, the fresh-docs reviewer and the layout-check. Nothing was merged: the commits went straight to the main tree.

- **Why the views looked unwired:** the day tree read the frozen `directory.json`, so it showed nothing for any day after 2026-10-09. `tree.js` now reads the dev server's task index instead, and today's [Task tree](/framework/ext/AITask/tree/) shows again.
- **Default view:** Lanes for a task with up to 8 direct subtasks, Outline above that. This run has 29, and Flow runs off the pane at that size. `?view=outline` is the route.
- **Where each one shows:** all three are on the Tree tab and on the [Task tree](/framework/ext/AITask/tree/) page. I added no separate card-page flow because the task page is the page a card opens.
- **The map:** [doc/views.md](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/views/) lists every view file, who uses it, when it was built and a screenshot of each. `feed.js` is wired to nothing, and `feed.js` and the unused `replay()` export are listed as candidates to retire. Nothing was deleted.
- **Not done:** the task index rows have no `parent_task` or `after`. A subtask's tree is therefore nested by folder and phased by start time, and "waiting" marks won't show. Adding those two fields in `Server/SessionIndex.mjs` would make it exact.
